author: Diego Sandoval
title: D'Angelo Russell exercises player option with Wizards for 2026-27 season
desc: D'Angelo Russell opted into his $6-million player option for the 2026-27 season with the Washington Wizards on Friday.
impact: Russell was traded to Washington last season in the Anthony Davis trade, but he never suited up for the team. His future with the Wizards has always been a question mark, and there is still a chance he could be traded even though he has opted into his player option.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Austin Reaves to draw interest from Pistons if he reaches UFA
desc: The Pistons are reportedly expected to show interest in Austin Reaves if he reaches unrestricted free agency.
impact: Reaves is expected to decline his $14.9 million player option for the 2026-27 season. It remains unclear how much interest the Lakers will have in re-signing him.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Isaiah Stewart available for trade
desc: Isaiah Stewart is reportedly available in a trade this offseason.
impact: Stewart averaged double digit scoring for the third time in four seasons this past year. He has one more year left before reaching a club option in his deal.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Derrick White drawing interest from Timberwolves
desc: The Timberwolves reportedly have strong interest in Derrick White.
impact: White still has two more years left in his deal before he reaches a player option. This would have to be a trade this offseason, likely more so if Boston acquires Giannis Antetokounmpo.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Trey Murphy III drawing interest from Celtics
desc: The Celtics are showing interest in Trey Murphy III.
impact: Murphy could be a "plan B" for Boston if it can't land Giannis Antetokounmpo. He is coming off back-to-back seasons averaging 21 points per game for New Orleans.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Ayo Dosunmu: Timberwolves 'very motivated' to reach new deal
desc: The Timberwolves are reportedly "very motivated" to re-sign Ayo Dosunmu.
impact: Dosunmu emerged late last season and into the postseason when injuries hit the Wolves back court. He will likely draw interest from other teams as well in free agency.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Kristaps Porzingis, Warriors progressing in talks on new deal
desc: The Warriors and Kristaps Porzingis are reportedly progressing in talks on a new deal.
impact: Porzingis appeared in 15 games with 11 starts for Golden State this past season after he was acquired by them at the trade deadline. The Warriors are continuing to go all-in around Stephen Curry.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Isaiah Joe drawing interest from Pistons
desc: The Pistons have reportedly shown interest in Isaiah Joe.
impact: After signing an extension with the Thunder, Joe has a club option next offseason before he becomes an unrestricted free agent. Detroit could be interested in a trade as the Thunder likely look to make some moves this offseason after falling short of the NBA Finals.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Coby White drawing interest from Pistons
desc: The Pistons are reportedly showing interest in Coby White.
impact: White was acquired by the Hornets in the middle of last season who he played 21 games with. He is one of three guards Detroit is expressing interest in heading into free agency.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Trae Young to opt out of final season of contract with Wizards
desc: Trae Young plans to opt out of the final season of his contract and become an unrestricted free agent.
impact: Young was acquired from the Hawks in early January and appeared in only five games for the Wizards. Washington remains the front-runner to sign Young, but he'll still figure to draw interest from other teams.

author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Alex Sarr undergoes foot surgery
desc: Alex Sarr underwent surgery to repair a fractured right foot on Monday.
impact: Sarr suffered the injury on a contact play during an offseason workout late last week. He is expected to be ready for the start of the season and will look to build on career highs of 16.3 points, 7.4 rebounds, 2.7 assists and two blocks per game across 48 games last season.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Luke Kornet (illness) available Saturday
desc: Luke Kornet is available for Game 5 of the NBA Finals on Saturday against the Knicks.
impact: Kornet is good to go after being listed as questionable. He'll remain in a very minimal role off the bench.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Mitchell Robinson (finger) listed available for Game 5 Saturday
desc: Mitchell Robinson is available for Saturday's Game 5 against the Spurs.
impact: Robinson is back on the injury report, but he is good to go. He will remain in his reserve role behind Karl-Anthony Towns.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Victor Wembanyama: No flagrant foul upgrade by NBA
desc: There was no flagrant upgrade on the uncalled foul of Victor Wembanyama to Jalen Brunson on Monday night in Game 3.
impact: Wembanyama will stay at two flagrant points in postseason. The Knicks lead the series 2-1 going into Wednesday.
